title: TileCas: Cascading Kernel Development Across Programming Abstractions
abstract: arXiv:2610.14740v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Programming abstractions have traditionally been designed for humans, but code generation is increasingly performed by models and autonomous agents. We investigate abstractions for machine-driven programming through GPU and AI-accelerator kernel generation. High-level domain-specific languages (DSLs) simplify search by delegating implementation details to compilers, while lower-level representations provide finer-grained control at the cost of a larger and more complex search space. In this paper, we present TileCas, a unified, pluggable interface that enables coding agents to develop kernels across multiple editable abstraction levels. translated_title: TileCas：跨编程抽象的级联内核开发
translated_abstract: 编程抽象传统上是为人类设计的，但代码生成越来越多地由模型和自主智能体来完成。我们通过GPU和AI加速器内核生成来研究面向机器驱动编程的抽象。高级领域特定语言（DSL）通过将实现细节委托给编译器来简化搜索，而低级表示则以更大且更复杂的搜索空间为代价提供更细粒度的控制。本文提出了TileCas，一个统一的、可插拔的接口，使编码智能体能够在多个可编辑的抽象层次上开发内核。TileCas不局限于单一表示，而是允许智能体通过跨层诊断在不同层次间迁移和改进候选方案——跨层诊断将正确性和性能反馈映射为不同抽象层次上可操作的控制；抽象调度则在两者之间进行选择……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TileCas提出一个统一可插拔的接口，让编码智能体能够通过跨层诊断和抽象调度，在多个可编辑的编程抽象层次之间迁移和改进内核开发，从而兼顾高级DSL的搜索简便性与低级表示的细粒度控制。
en_tdlr: TileCas introduces a unified, pluggable interface that enables coding agents to develop kernels across multiple editable abstraction levels via Cross-Level Diagnosis and Abstraction Scheduling, balancing the search simplicity of high-level DSLs with the fine-grained control of low-level representations.
